title: Add lazy loading for all images in the Admin Dashboard

requirements.text: Implement lazy loading for all images rendered anywhere inside the Admin Dashboard (all tabs), using the existing `LazyImage` component so admin pages do not eagerly download every image at once.

quotes: Can you please implement last loading for all the admin dashboard imeges?

acceptanceCriteria: All `` usages within Admin Dashboard-related components are replaced with `LazyImage` where applicable (e.g., report photos, proof photos, representative photos, logo previews, and any other images shown in admin flows).
Images only start downloading when they are near/inside the viewport (or immediately when marked as high priority).
Above-the-fold/critical images (e.g., images visible immediately in an opened modal or a primary preview) use `priority="high"` so they load eagerly when needed.
While an image is loading, a non-jarring placeholder/skeleton is visible and the layout does not shift significantly.

requirements.text: Apply lazy loading to image-heavy admin surfaces specifically, including reports management (tables/cards, edit previews, and full-size preview modals), directory representative photos (lists/cards and photo modals), and content/logo management previews.

quotes: Can you please implement last loading for all the admin dashboard imeges?

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Reports UI: photos shown in lists/cards and any expanded/edit views use lazy loading and show placeholders until loaded.
Admin Directory UI: representative photos use lazy loading in lists/cards, and any photo modal loads the image eagerly when opened (priority high).
Admin Content Management UI: logo preview `` elements use lazy loading; the preview modal loads its image eagerly when opened (priority high).

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose these components instead).
Do not modify any files in `frontend` marked as immutable by the system context (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`).
nonGoals: Do not change backend canister interfaces or storage formats.
Do not introduce new authentication/authorization behavior for admins.
Do not redesign admin workflows beyond what is required to lazy-load images.
